# Dandelion

Type: Material | Internal ID: Dandelion | Source: Meadows, biome | Usage: Building, Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

## Availability

• Found on the ground in the Meadows biome. Picked dandelions will respawn in the same location after 240 minutes.
• Dropped by Greydwarf brute.

### Building

• Spice rack
• Maypole
• Yellow banner
• Yuleklapp (medium)

### Crafting

• Midsummer crown
• Mead base: Medium healing
• Mead base: Minor healing
• Mead base: Vananidir
• Whole roasted Meadow boar
• Yellow firework

Categorias: Materials
